## Error handler
Set as Error Workflow in the settings of 00, 10 and 20. Any failure → email to hello@, Telegram ping, and a Failed row in Notion › Runs. Each channel fails independently, so one broken channel never hides the alert.

**Telegram separation (v2):** errors go to the second bot *Waypoint alerts* (credential "Telegram alerts"), never to the approval bot. The approval chat only holds things that need a decision; the alerts chat can be muted.
